Explanatory Note
This amendment on Form 10-K/A amends the Comstock Resources, Inc. Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2019, as filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission ("SEC") on March 2, 2020. This amendment amends Item 15 in response to a comment letter from the staff of the SEC.
As required by Rule 12b-15 under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the "Exchange Act"), we are also filing new certifications by the Company's Principal Executive Officer and Principal Financial Officer as Exhibits 31.1, 31.2, 32.1 and 32.2 to this form 10-K/A under Item 15. Exhibits and Financial Statement Schedules.
